headline: Apple, Alphabet, JB Hunt And Howmet Aerospace: CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
summary: Experts on CNBC's Halftime Report Final Trades recommend staying long on Apple (AAPL), Howmet Aerospace (HWM), Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), and J B Hunt Transport (JBHT).
